fact: The Daily Nation reports that the IEBC chairman gazetted 29 September 2025 for resuming continuous voter registration, letting Kenyans register, transfer, correct details or inspect their records at any of the 290 constituency offices.

The Standard reports a court order that the IEBC give parties and observers access to the source code and audit logs of its continuous voter registration system to monitor its ongoing operations, with biometric voter identification used in the 2026 by-elections.
A KPMG audit of the 2022 register, quoted in court, found 164,269 registrations with ID numbers invalid against National Registration Bureau records.

The article says Smartmatic supplied KIEMS kits used for biometric voter registration, electronic voter identification and result transmission in Kenya's 2022 general election, and that IEBC is targeting 6.3 million new voters ahead of 2027.
